response.content: Operator: Welcome to the Microsoft Fiscal Year 2023 Second Quarter Earnings Conference Call. Satya Nadella: Thank you... Amy Hood: Thanks, Satya. Revenue was $52.7 billion, up 2%...
Elon Musk: Good afternoon everyone. Q2 was a challenging quarter due to supply chain disruptions... Zachary Kirkhorn: Automotive gross margin was 27.9%...
Andy Jassy: Thanks for joining. AWS grew 39% year over year... Brian Olsavsky: Operating income was $4.9 billion...
